name: perego-theme/media-lightbox
title: Perego Media Lightbox
description: The site-wide accessible image/video/gallery lightbox dialog (ported from the handoff's main.js lightbox IIFE). Renders once per page in the footer template part; its view script delegates a click listener to every [data-image]/[data-video]/[data-gallery] trigger anywhere on the page, so any block can open it without wiring its own dialog.
